intro: CAVA Unsweetened Black Tea (22 oz) offers a pure, refreshing beverage option for health-conscious diners. This zero-calorie drink features premium brewed black tea without added sugars or sweeteners. Perfect for pairing with any item from the [full CAVA menu](/), this classic beverage provides authentic tea flavor in a generous 22-ounce serving at $3.85.
priceCalories: Priced at $3.85 for the 22 oz size, CAVA Unsweetened Black Tea contains 0 calories with no protein, carbs, or fat. This makes it an ideal choice for those monitoring their caloric intake while enjoying a flavorful drink. The larger portion size offers excellent value compared to other options on the [CAVA Drinks Menu](/menu/drinks).
whatMakesSpecial: What sets this beverage apart is its simplicity and purity. Made from just brewed black tea with no additives, sweeteners, or artificial ingredients, it delivers authentic tea taste. The 22 oz serving provides ample refreshment to complement your entire meal, from [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) selections to pitas and sides.
nutritionFacts: With a perfect nutritional profile of 0 calories, 0g protein, 0g carbs, and 0g fat, this unsweetened black tea is completely calorie-free. It contains no sugar, making it suitable for various dietary preferences including keto, low-carb, and diabetic-friendly diets. Check the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) for complete meal planning.
whatsInside: The ingredient list could not be simpler: brewed black tea. CAVA uses quality tea leaves steeped to perfection, creating a clean, authentic beverage without preservatives, sweeteners, or flavor enhancers. This straightforward approach ensures you get pure tea flavor with every sip, complementing meals from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) beautifully.
tasteLike: CAVA Unsweetened Black Tea delivers a classic, smooth tea flavor with natural tannins and subtle earthy notes. The taste is clean and refreshing without any sweetness, allowing the pure black tea character to shine through. Its mild astringency and rich amber color provide an authentic tea-drinking experience that cleanses the palate between bites.
customize: While this beverage comes unsweetened by default, you can personalize it to your preference. Request lemon wedges on the side for a citrus twist, or ask for ice adjustments if you prefer less dilution. Some guests enjoy adding their own sweetener packets, though the pure tea flavor is designed to be enjoyed as-is.
pairsWell: This unsweetened black tea pairs exceptionally well with Mediterranean flavors across the menu. It complements rich options from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads) and balances spicy or savory dishes. The clean taste refreshes your palate when enjoying bold dressings, grilled proteins, or flavorful toppings throughout your meal.
healthyChoice: As a zero-calorie beverage, Unsweetened Black Tea is an excellent healthy choice for anyone watching their sugar or calorie intake. Black tea naturally contains antioxidants and may support metabolism without adding to your daily nutritional totals. It hydrates without compromising dietary goals, making it ideal for fitness-focused diners exploring the [CAVA Gluten Free Menu](/gluten-free).
howToOrder: Order the Unsweetened Black Tea (22 oz) directly at the counter or through CAVA app and online ordering. Simply add it to your meal when selecting beverages. The 22 oz size provides enough refreshment for your entire dining experience. Specify any ice preferences or request lemon wedges when placing your order.
vsAlternatives: Compared to Classic Lemonade (22 oz) at 360 calories and Blueberry Lavender (22 oz) at 190 calories, the Unsweetened Black Tea offers a calorie-free alternative. While sweetened drinks provide fruity flavors, this option delivers pure tea taste without sugar. Both sizes are priced at $3.85, making the larger portion ideal for extended refreshment.
whoShouldTry: This beverage is perfect for tea enthusiasts, health-conscious diners, and anyone avoiding sugar or calories in their drinks. Those following keto, low-carb, or diabetic diets will appreciate the zero-calorie profile. It is also ideal for guests who prefer subtle, natural flavors over sweet beverages while enjoying items from the [CAVA Desserts Menu](/menu/desserts).
worthTrying: Absolutely worth trying for anyone seeking a refreshing, guilt-free beverage option. At $3.85 for 22 oz with zero calories, it offers exceptional value and versatility. The pure brewed black tea provides authentic flavor that enhances rather than competes with your meal, making it a smart choice for health-focused diners at CAVA.
